items.t: Domino's® Fires Up Flavor with the Launch of New Sweet Heat Smokehouse Pizza
items.sum: Domino's Pizza Inc. (Nasdaq: DPZ) is turning up the flavor with the launch of its newest Specialty Pizza: the Sweet Heat Smokehouse, which combines smoky, sweet and spicy ingredients to deliver a bold flavor experience in every bite. It launches at Domino's stores nationwide, beginning today.

items.t: Pizza Hut Sells $1 Billion of Bonds Tied to Franchise Agreements
items.sum: Pizza Hut sold $1 billion of bonds on Monday to help fund its buyout by private equity fund LongRange Capital LLC, according to a person with knowledge of the matter.

items.t: Today's S&P 500 Top Movers: Tyson Foods Leads Gainers, Lumentum Leads Decliners
